operations.summary: The Jira account Aurora is connected as
The projects the account can see (key, name); answer is a JSON array

params.name: expand
params.description: Comma-separated extras, e.g. description,lead

params.name: recent
params.description: Only the N projects most recently viewed by the account

operations.summary: One project with its issueTypes (id, name, subtask), needed before creating an issue

params.name: projectIdOrKey
params.description: Project key such as ABC, or its numeric id

params.name: expand
params.description: Comma-separated extras, e.g. description,lead

operations.summary: Issues matching a JQL query; fields= limits the fields returned; total above maxResults means more pages via startAt

params.name: jql
params.description: JQL, e.g. project = ABC AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC

params.name: startAt
params.description: Index of the first issue returned; page by adding maxResults while startAt + maxResults < total

params.name: maxResults
params.description: At most this many issues (the server may cap it, often at 1000)

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated, e.g. summary,status,updated,labels; leave out for all fields (large)

params.name: expand
params.description: Comma-separated extras, e.g. changelog,renderedFields

params.name: validateQuery
params.description: strict (default) refuses an invalid JQL, warn answers with warnings, none skips the check

operations.summary: One issue; fields= limits the fields returned

params.name: issueIdOrKey
params.description: Issue key such as ABC-123, or its numeric id

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated, e.g. summary,status,description; leave out for all fields

params.name: expand
params.description: Comma-separated extras, e.g. changelog,renderedFields

params.name: issueIdOrKey

params.description: At most this many comments

params.name: orderBy

params.name: issueIdOrKey

params.description: Comment id from list_issue_comments
